FSBTY1 Index.name: Bloomberg Fair Value/ICE Brent
FSBTY1 Index.des_notes:
The methodology used to derive the curves in the sector can be found in {HELP CFVL } in the Reference Documents section. An oil product Fair Value using ticker M0 is pricing the balance of month tenor

Bloomberg Commodity Fair Value prices are calculated through a proprietary model that uses futures prices, historical spreads,spot prices and other factors. Updates are posted throughout the day. The Fair Values for oil products have used tenor M0 for the balance of month.

TTFGCY1 Index.name: Netherlands TTF Natural Gas Fo
TTFGCY1 Index.des_notes:
SECTOR DESCRIPTION: Physical Forward Prices for natural gas delivered to Virtual Trading Point Netherlands Title Transfer Facility (TTF). The Title Transfer Facility, more commonly known as TTF, is a virtual trading point for natural gas in the Netherlands. This trading point provides facility for a number of traders in Netherlands to trade futures, physical and exchange trades. Set up by Gasunie in 2003, it is almost identical to the National Balancing Point (NBP) in the United Kingdom and allows gas to be traded within the Dutch Gas network.

More information on TTF can be found here https://www.gasunietransportservices.nl/en/shippers/products-and-services/ttf

Product Specifications: Units: EUR/Mwh

Gas trades on a forward month,forward quarter,forward season or year forward basis.
Day-ahead = delivered next working day (Friday's Price reflects Monday delivery)
Weekend = delivered Saturday, Sunday
Week + 1 = delivered Monday-Friday of the front week
Months: All months are calendar months
Quarters: Q1 = January to March, Q2 = April to June, Q3 = July to September, Q4 = October to December
Seasonal contracts are as follows:
Summer - Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep;
Winter - Oct(Yr1), Nov(Yr1), Dec(Yr1), Jan(Yr2),Feb(Yr2),Mar(Yr2).
Calendar Year - Contracts are Jan-Dec. Gas Year contracts are Oct-Sep Close

SOURCE: Data comes from brokers/third parties. Please run {ALLQ} to see the sources pricing
this ticker.

UPDATE INFO: Energy broker pricing on Bloomberg updates on a near real-time basis. It is
important to note that updates only occur when there is activity in the market, so there may not be
updates on every contract every day.

SOURCE METHODOLOGY: N/A

HISTORICAL CONSIDERATIONS: N/A

DATA DISCOVERY: Generic contracts run continuously and link the underlying specific contracts.
Generics are rolled in order to maintain the correct reference forward contract. For example,
{TTFG1MON Index DES} represents the first month forward.

Specific contracts can be found by running 'TTFG' followed by M (Month), Q (Quarter), S (Season)
or Y (Year).
For example:
{TTFGM F15 Index DES} - Jan 2015
{TTFGQ Q115 Index DES} - Q1 2015
{TTFGS SU15 Index DES} - Summer 2015
{TTFGS WI1516 Index DES} - Winter 2015/16
{TTFGY 15 Index DES} - Year 2015
The month contract codes are:
Jan-F Feb-G Mar-H Apr-J May-K Jun-M Jul-N Aug-Q Sep-U Oct-V Nov-X Dec-Z

RELATED SECTORS/FUNCTIONS:
{ALLX GPTT } - German GPL/ Dutch TTF Hi Cal Natural Gas Forward Prices
{ALLX EGTF } - Natural Gas Forward German NCG/ Dutch TTF Hi Cal Forward Prices

USE AS A FINANCIAL BENCHMARK MAY BE RESTRICTED. SEE {DOCS #2084680}

PRIB03M Index.name: Czech Interbank Offered Rates
PRIB03M Index.des_notes:
Czech Interbank Offered Rates 1 Month PRIBOR (or Prague Interbank Offered Rate) is the average interest rate at which unsecured CZK funds are offered by Panel Banks in the interbank market, just prior to 11.00am local time. The calculation of PRIBOR shall take place at 11:00am Prague local time. Individual Panel Bank contributions shall be published at 15:00. Relevant documentation may be found at: https://cfbf.cz/pribor/governance-oversight/code-of-conduct/ and https://cfbf.cz/pribor/

Real-time PRIBOR data is fee-liable. Non-subscribers receive 24-hour delayed data on Terminal. From 1st Jan 2026, a CFBF license is required for delayed Data License access. Non-subscribers will lose access over DL 16th June 2026. Contact subscriptions@cfbf.cz for licensing. Real-time users require EID 74556 . Delayed Data License users require EID 100499.

CZIPITN Index.name: Czech Republic Industrial Prod
CZIPITN Index.des_notes: Industrial production measures the output of industrial establishments in the following industries: mining and quarrying, manufacturing and public utilities (electricity, gas and water supply). Production is based on the volume of the output.

CZGRIDX Index.name: Total Number of Granted Buildi
CZGRIDX Index.des_notes: This concept tracks the number of permits that have been issued for new construction, additions to pre-existing structures or major renovations. These statistics are based on the number of construction permits approved.

LCTQCZI Index.name: Eurostat Unit Labor Cost Nomin
LCTQCZI Index.des_notes: This concept tracks the growth in employee compensation relative to real output. Unit labor costs are generally calculated by dividing total labor compensation by real gross domestic product.

LCTOCZI Index.name: Eurostat Unit Labor Cost Nomin
LCTOCZI Index.des_notes: This concept tracks the growth in employee compensation relative to real output. Unit labor costs are generally calculated by dividing total labor compensation by real gross domestic product.

EUS3CZ Index.name: EU Services Evolution of Deman
EUS3CZ Index.des_notes: This concept tracks business sentiment within the services industries. The results are based on a survey conducted among a representative sample of businesses in the services sector.

EUS5CZ Index.name: EU Services Evolution of Emplo
EUS5CZ Index.des_notes: This concept tracks business sentiment within the services industries. The results are based on a survey conducted among a representative sample of businesses in the services sector.

EUB3CZ Index.name: EC Construction Confidence Cze
EUB3CZ Index.des_notes: This concept tracks business sentiment within the construction industry. The results are based on a survey conducted among a representative sample of businesses in the construction sector.

GRCPHCPI Index.name: Germany Harmonized Consumer Pr
GRCPHCPI Index.des_notes: The harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP), used primarily within the European Union, is a measure of prices paid by consumers for a market basket of goods and services. It is calculated using the same methodology across countries to allow for comparable measures of inflation. The yearly (or monthly) growth rates represent the inflation rate.

UMRTDE Index.name: Eurostat Unemployment Germany
UMRTDE Index.des_notes: The unemployment rate tracks the number of unemployed persons as a percentage of the labor force (the total number of employed plus unemployed). These figures generally come from a household labor force survey.

CZEII Index.name: Czech Republic Import Prices
CZEII Index.des_notes: Import price indexes track changes in the prices of goods produced abroad and sold domestically (imports).

LONSCZNF Index.name: Czech Republic Non-Financial C
LONSCZNF Index.des_notes: This concept tracks the aggregate assets and liabilities of banks within an economy (including private or commercial banks, central banks or both).
